STAMP REFRESHED, NUMBER UNCHANGED. 'ruff check odoo/ --no-cache' exits 0 in a clean detached worktree of ed0d70a60d6, which is what a hard zero means. Re-stamped because the old stamp named a commit the 2026-09-02 sync replayed away.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMPED, NOT MOVED. The floor carried no `measured_at` at all, so it was a number nobody could reproduce: the guard that refuses a stamp this branch never had cannot fire on a floor with no stamp, and an unstamped floor may never have been true of any tree. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- ruff==0.16.2 alone on PATH, ruff check odoo/ --no-cache --statistics summed -- and it reads 0, equal to the floor. The count does not move; only the stamp does.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

Still 0; the SCOPE changed, not the count. The gate measured `ruff check odoo/ --no-cache --ignore D --statistics` while pydocstyle sat on its own ruff_docstring floor. D is now retired from ruff.toml `select` outright -- eff67f80316 stripped docstrings from odoo/ on purpose and the floor over what that left could only be paid down by re-adding them -- so the command drops the flag and is simply `ruff check odoo/ --no-cache --statistics`. The two are identical against a config that does not select D; the flag is dropped rather than kept as a no-op because it would assert a carve-out this gate no longer has and point the next reader at a floor that no longer exists.

Earlier history, which is what bought the hard zero, is unchanged: 759 -> 0 when D moved out (758 of the 759 were D1xx, and the 1 remaining was a real F401 -- unused `threading` in odoo/service/model.py -- that had been invisible inside the aggregate).
